_what: Who fills the picker role in creator_picks.py. command null = the built-in default (proven sources only (TrendTrack ads already swept, TikTok Shop videos), each ranked on its proof, the winners slot from runs/winners/<brand>/brief-next.json on top). Set command to a repo-relative script (e.g. the creative-strategist component's picker) that prints [{"item", "why"}] (item = "trendtrack:<ad id>" or "tiktok-shop:<post id>") for --brand B --max N, and filled_by to its name; the door does not change. owner_yes true = picks wait as draft until creator_picks.py mark --approve.
filled_by: default: proven sources ranked on proof + winners slot

mix._what: How a week's picks are split between the two kinds of source. `market_now` = what the avatar's market is watching now (the organic feeds); `adjacent` = adjacent markets and competitors (the proven paid sources this picker reads). The two numbers are parts of a whole: 4 and 1 means four picks in five from the market's own feeds and one in five from adjacent markets and competitors. `applies` false = the split is worked out and printed with every pick run and written on each pick, and changes no pick; true = this picker takes only the adjacent side's share of the week. The numbers are the default offered 2026-11-18; `applies` turns on only by the owner's ruling.
